absent: Transformation semantics of individual table helpers beyond orchestration, ordering, and locking shown.
Virtual area initialization content and release path beyond cache allocation.
Readahead descriptor layout and caching policy beyond forced prefetch invocation.
Reclaim vector insertion, removal, and accounting beyond move callbacks and locking.
Deferred split queue lifecycle and partially mapped accounting beyond unqueue path.
Workqueue topology and per processor drain work lifecycle beyond scheduling and flushing.

findings.text: Allocator supplies a virtual area descriptor associated with a given address space, signalling cache exhaustion with a null return.
Helper provides a mapped lower table entry together with its table lock, restarting the sequence when the upper entry is observed to change while locking.
Lookup offers lockless access to a lower table entry, refusing to map when the upper entry is absent, not present, huge, or malformed.
File advice handling adjusts caching posture, triggers voluntary prefetch, or discards cached range data according to the supplied hint.
Range flushing requests nonblocking writeback over a byte interval, skipping work when the mapping cannot write back or has no dirty marking.
Drain interfaces shift locally staged folios toward global reclaim handling, available in local, single processor, and system-wide forms.
Initialization-time validation exercises table transformations across protection combinations and mutating operations under matching locks, then tears down its fixtures.
Test setup prefers the largest available transparent huge backing for trial frames, degrading through smaller huge and single page options and skipping dependent checks when allocation fails.
Lockless upper entry sampling exists in two interrupt handling postures selected by build, one preserving interrupt state and one applying no masking.
Writeback over an interval attaches the owning inode for the duration of the operation and reports back remaining work when requested.
Advice against direct access or no-operation backing accepts valid hints without performing caching effects and rejects unknown hints.
Discard processing keeps partially covered edge pages, retains the final page unless aligned or at end of file, and does nothing when no whole pages remain.
Prefetch range computation treats zero length as unbounded, clamps arithmetic overflow to maximum, and guards page count wrapping.
Mutating validation holds the lock matching the level under test, using the mapped lower lock, the middle level locks, and the address space table lock for upper levels.
Caching mode flag changes serialize under the file lock, while readahead window adjustments are performed without that lock.
Batch migration toward reclaim vectors performs vector relocking with interrupts disabled and releases the final vector once the batch is consumed.
System-wide drain scheduling serializes concurrent initiators and publishes a generation marker with ordering guarantees so concurrently staged batches are not missed.
Local draining uses per-processor batch protection, employing interrupt-aware guarding for the queue that can race interrupt context.
Deferred split detachment runs under read-side protection while holding the node and group aware list lock for the owning structure.
Locked folio residency transitions between evictable and unevictable tracking driven by evictability and nesting count, with distinct accounting for rescue, cull, unlock, and strand outcomes.
Discard escalates from local flushing with a first invalidation attempt to global flushing with a second invalidation pass when the first pass reports remote residency.
Lower mapping under lock samples the upper entry without locks, acquires the derived lock, and restarts when revalidation shows divergence.
Deferred split removal is gated on large remappable queued folios, using a fast unsynchronized emptiness test before the synchronized removal attempt.
Evictability is refused while the owning mapping is unevictable or a lock mark is present, assessed under protection against concurrent mapping release.
Observation of a malformed upper entry during lockless lookup reports the condition and clears that entry instead of establishing a mapping.
Addition draining isolates folios that reach zero references mid-drain, clearing inapplicable state and freeing them through a separate batch after unlocking.
Batch moves other than addition ignore entries already detached from reclaim tracking.
Validation covers protection values from empty up to the combination of shared with execute, write, and read permissions.
Per processor staging groups distinct queues for addition, tail movement, deactivation paths, lazy release, and activation.
Validation fixture bundles an address space with table accessors, a trial address, trial frame identifiers, and placeholders for swap and migration values.
Memory lock staging packs the requested operation into reclaimed low pointer bits that are removed before per folio handling.
Activation draining has present and absent build forms, the present form forwarding any pending activation batch through generic movement.
Memory lock draining and its pending-work check each have active and no-operation build forms tied to a dedicated per processor batch.
Voluntary prefetch constructs a readahead context from file, mapping, and start position to drive the requested amount of caching.
